profile.headline: Head of Operations and Technology at Build Hill
profile.summary: Software Engineer experienced in building performant and creative full-stack applications using JavaScript, React, Node.js, and SQL/NoSQL databases. As a lifelong artist, I am highly passionate about UI/UX design principles, accessibility, and the open-source community.

positions.title: Head of Operations and Technology
positions.locationName: Park City, Utah, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Designed and built a custom project management platform (Next.js, React, Supabase) that centralizes schedules, budgets, documents, and communication across all active builds.
- Developed a client portal that lets homeowners check build progress in real time, giving out-of-town clients visibility and cutting down on status-update calls and emails.
- Created a time-tracking system for hourly crews, replacing manual timekeeping with accurate, easy-to-audit hours by project.
- Established the Build Hill brand from the ground up, including the logo, brand guidelines, and company website, plus the supporting marketing and photography.
- Partnered with architects and interior designers to capture and organize project details, selections, and revisions, keeping design intent and construction aligned.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Project Management · Next.js · React.js · Full-Stack Development · Supabase · PostgreSQL · Brand Identity · Digital Marketing · Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · SASS · Node.js · JavaScript · Redux.js · WordPress · React.js · Tailwind CSS · Faust.js · Bootstrap · Next.js

positions.title: Creative Technologist
positions.description:
- Grow and develop the new Creative Technology team at the country's largest privately owned Advertising Agency
- Self learn and develop skills in Unreal Engine, Web Development, Instagram/Snap filter development, and team management to present ideas to multiple clients working with the agency
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Unreal Engine · Spark AR Studio

positions.title: Web Development Teaching Assistant
positions.description: - Taught classes of 30+ students in front-end web development languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in the school of Digital Humanities.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · jQuery

positions.title: Art Director
positions.description:
- Programmed a recruiting fair website to display 120 seniors’ portfolios for recruiters to schedule interviews by using MySQL, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
- Won a national Bronze Telly award by working with an interdisciplinary team to highlight the nearly 200,000 people affected by Chronic Regional Pain Syndrome in the US.
- Build a portfolio of 20+ projects on different brands with peers to present to 100+ recruiters at the annual Sundance Recruiting Fair for seniors.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · PHP · SQL

honors.title: Telly Awards Bronze Winner - Online Commercials
honors.description: Worked with an interdisciplinary team to highlight the nearly 200,000 people affected by Chronic Regional Pain Syndrome(CRPS) in the US. I guided the art direction, casting, and location for this project.

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked with patients once a week to conduct healthy activities related to art projects.
Participated in helping children in arts programs. Volunteered at the Kimball Arts Festival in the summer. Helped run tables at events.
